entities.summary: Sigulda is a town and the centre of Sigulda Municipality in the Vidzeme region of Latvia, 53 kilometres from the capital city Riga. It's an important tourist center of Latvia. Its territory also includes the ancient centers of Turaida and Krimulda. At the beginning of 2024, Sigulda had 14,632 inhabitants, making it the 15th largest settlement in Latvia.
